issues.detail: The Hebrew 'הַבְּעָלִים' (the Baals) is rendered as '主人的' (the master's), which changes the referent from the pagan deity Baal to a generic 'master'. This is a mistranslation of a proper name/divine title.
The Hebrew 'הַמַּסֵּכוֹת' (the molten images/cast metal idols) is rendered as '幔子' (curtains/veils), which is a different object. The Hebrew term refers to cast metal idols, not curtains.
